quests.title: The Fruit Has Other Owners
quests.text: The canopy spirits asked me to settle a quarrel over fruit; the Cloud Apes settled their part by throwing it at my messengers. Kill five by day in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood}. A fistful of fruit is a poor argument, however loudly you make it.

quests.title: Teach the Drum to Scratch
quests.text: Our shrine drum needs a voice that will make even the canopy spirits sit up. Kill four Glass Panthers at night in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood}, and bring me two Gleaming Cat Claws. I'll do the playing. You have the difficult part: asking the cats for an instrument.

quests.title: The Canopy Names Its Price
quests.text: I asked the canopy spirits what the shrine owed them, and they answered with a hiss. Kill five Vine Serpents by day in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}, which lie {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}, and bring me two Glass Venom. Next time I bargain with a tree, remind me to settle the price before asking for favours.

quests.title: Promises with Bowstrings
quests.text: Paymaster Chirr promises his archers wages for holding land, then pays them in branded coin for every mark they burn into living roots. His payroll lists both banners, and he makes the forest carry the debt for their dead. Kill four Last-Pay Archers or Ash-Writ Bowmen in all at the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, {dir_from_giver:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, by day or night, and kill Chirr. Smother the burning rootmark at {name:r20_anchor_084} to erase the names scorched there; the roots have complained about it louder than the spirits.

quests.title: Party: More Than One Voice
quests.text: Serpent Glass-Throat has grown fat among the burnt roots of the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}, {dir_from_giver:glass_throat_serpent}. The canopy spirits stop talking whenever its coils move; even my drum gets a very careful answer. Gather a party and kill the elite serpent, so the next song from those branches can use more than a whisper.

quests.title: Bounty: Paws Between Drumbeats
quests.text: The spirits say the Gloom Panthers know how to step between our drumbeats, and I believe them. Kill five at night in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}, which lies {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}, and return for the shrine's reward. This bounty opens again twenty minutes after turn-in; I will try a different rhythm while you rest.
